notes: Self-declared tycoon with a spend-points-to-grow-bigger-plants loop, so Simulation; the pomodoro timer is the earning mechanic rather than a second genre, and there is no space it adds. Shape is plot-isolated rather than the Tycoon preset's plot-shared because the answers put every player on their own sub-100-stud plot, all visibly arranged alongside each other in one shared world. The Focus Desk is trigger-task and the Unlock Pad gating the eight progressively bigger plants is gate-progression, with path-circulation threading the row of plots. I dropped the preset's social-hub: the prompt keeps upgrades on the player's own Unlock Pad and pauses the timer the moment they leave their plot boundary, which contradicts a central storefront everyone has to walk back to.
